comparison_type: Documentation-based candidate qualification, not a measured accuracy benchmark

groups.decision: Retain validated HydroLAKES for compatibility; qualify LakeATLAS for attribute enrichment and SWOT PLD for smaller-lake inventory needs.

alternatives.name: LakeATLAS v1
alternatives.relationship: Enrichment of the same HydroLAKES features
alternatives.when_to_choose: Lake environmental characteristics and catchment context, rather than geometry alone.
alternatives.differences: 56 hydro-environmental variables represented by 281 attributes. Same underlying HydroLAKES polygons, so this is not a newer independent shoreline survey.
alternatives.distribution: Producer Shapefile ZIP (~1.5 GB) or FileGDB ZIP (~1.43 GB); suitable GeoParquet candidate. Sizes are producer-rounded figures.
alternatives.rights: Producer states CC-BY-4.0 and points to technical documentation; review component attribute provenance before packaging.
alternatives.existing_sourcecoop: No exact entry identified in targeted search; absence not established.

sources.supports: LakeATLAS identity, attributes, formats, publisher sizes and overall license.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

sources.supports: HydroATLAS contains the corresponding base HydroLAKES/HydroRIVERS/HydroBASINS geometry and enriches attributes.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

alternatives.remaining: Check source IDs, field overlap and exact geometry equality before reusing our validated geometry artifact.

alternatives.name: SWOT Prior Lake Database
alternatives.relationship: Alternative lake inventory with different geometry and inclusion rules
alternatives.when_to_choose: Small lakes, contemporary mission inventory and linkage to SWOT observations.
alternatives.differences: The 2025 operational-PLD paper describes ~5.9 million polygons targeting lakes >=1 ha; HydroLAKES targets >=10 ha. PLD favors representative stable-season extents and excludes the Caspian Sea. Paper counts are not verified counts of the current scientific release.
alternatives.distribution: Hydroweb.next catalog identifies scientific release 2.02 Sci in SQLite; light and geometry collections also exist. GeoParquet would be a useful candidate representation.
alternatives.existing_sourcecoop: No exact entry identified in targeted search; current public cloud-native equivalent not established.

sources.supports: Operational inventory definition, thresholds, paper-era counts and representative extents.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

sources.supports: Current indexed producer catalog: scientific release 2.02 Sci, SQLite and ETALAB 2.0.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

alternatives.remaining: Direct catalog browser fetch timed out; indexed primary catalog text was available. Confirm current downloadable artifacts, size and geometry equivalence; do not use paper counts as current release verification.

groups.decision: Keep FFR when connectivity/free-flowing classifications are the requirement; use an existing network for general waterways.

alternatives.name: Fika WaterNet
alternatives.relationship: Alternative waterway network, not a free-flowing status assessment
alternatives.when_to_choose: Global river/stream mapping and network exploration, including model-predicted smaller waterways.
alternatives.differences: 20 m model outputs, vector topology and known coverage/vectorization artifacts; does not reproduce FFR connectivity index and pressure indicators.
alternatives.distribution: Already on Source Cooperative as GeoParquet, PMTiles and publisher-declared COGs.

sources.supports: Product purpose, 20 m model outputs, formats, topology fields, known limitations and terms.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

alternatives.remaining: Qualify regional fidelity and pin source versions. No need for another mirror solely for format conversion.

alternatives.name: RiverATLAS v1

alternatives.distribution: Producer FileGDB (~2.33 GB) or Shapefile (~2.55 GB) ZIP; potential GeoParquet representation.
alternatives.rights: Producer states CC-BY-4.0 and points to technical documentation; component provenance requires review.
alternatives.existing_sourcecoop: No exact entry identified in targeted search; absence not established.

sources.supports: RiverATLAS identity, formats, rounded sizes and general license.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

sources.supports: FFR purpose and connectivity assessment differ from a bare river network.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

groups.baseline: JRC Global Surface Water v1.5 Occurrence
groups.decision: Keep JRC for long-term occurrence; prefer existing OPERA/Dynamic World products when recent water mapping is the question.

alternatives.name: OPERA DSWx-HLS v1
alternatives.relationship: Frequent observed surface-water classification, not a multi-decade occurrence statistic
alternatives.when_to_choose: Contemporary water extent and change monitoring.
alternatives.differences: 30 m near-global water classifications with ancillary confidence/cloud/terrain layers. Current catalog lists a 2016-present span while its description specifies validated observations beginning April 2023; full historical coverage was not checked. Does not recreate JRC 1984-2024 occurrence by selecting a single band.
alternatives.distribution: Producer-declared COG at NASA PO.DAAC; data access uses Earthdata Login. Direct S3 access documented in us-west-2.
alternatives.rights: NASA use/citation policy and product-specific attribution apply; ancillary DEM terms are documented separately.
alternatives.existing_sourcecoop: Not needed to establish an existing cloud-native distribution; no SourceCoop mirror verified here.

sources.supports: COG format, 30 m resolution, listed time span, validation-period distinction and Earthdata authentication.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

sources.supports: JRC v1.5 Occurrence represents 1984-2024, unlike instantaneous water classification.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

alternatives.remaining: Check intended date/region coverage, cloud masking and access requirements. Do not infer anonymous access from COG format.

alternatives.name: Dynamic World v1
alternatives.relationship: Land-cover probabilities containing a water class
alternatives.when_to_choose: 10 m recent land-cover/water context from Sentinel-2 observations.
alternatives.differences: 2015-present, cloud-filtered/masked image-level predictions for nine land-cover classes; probability thresholding and temporal aggregation are decisions. It does not reproduce JRC historical water occurrence.
alternatives.distribution: Official Earth Engine image collection; independent cloud-native bulk distribution not verified.
alternatives.rights: Use the catalog-specific terms and attribution.

sources.supports: 10 m scale, 2015-present coverage, water-class probability/label semantics and cloud masking.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

alternatives.remaining: Not a reason to export a new mirror without a defined product, aggregation and access requirement.

groups.decision: Use CHELSA or ERA5-Land directly when their variables, period and access meet the need. Retain TerraClimate for its specific downscaled monthly water-balance product.

alternatives.name: CHELSA-monthly v2.1
alternatives.when_to_choose: Kilometer-scale climate mapping with overlapping temperature, precipitation, PET and moisture variables.
alternatives.differences: Producer monthly catalog lists 1979-2021, versus TerraClimate v1.1 base 1950-2025; finer nominal grid does not establish greater accuracy for every variable or region. Variable definitions and derived indices differ.
alternatives.distribution: Producer declares COG format; existing files may be registered after access qualification.
alternatives.existing_sourcecoop: No exact listing identified in targeted search; already cloud-native producer format does not depend on SourceCoop.

sources.supports: Global kilometer-scale monthly product, 1979-2021, variables, version 2.1, COG and CC0.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

alternatives.remaining: Monthly coverage is taken from current documentation, not an object inventory. Do not substitute CHELSA climatologies for a monthly time series.

alternatives.name: ERA5-Land
alternatives.relationship: Alternative land reanalysis with different resolution and modeling
alternatives.when_to_choose: Hourly climate/land-surface reanalysis from 1950 onward, with selected variables already in Zarr.
alternatives.differences: About 9 km native resolution versus TerraClimate about 4 km; can be aggregated monthly but does not reproduce TerraClimate values or its exact derived water-balance definitions. TerraClimate v1.1 names ERA5 as an input, not ERA5-Land; do not conflate them.
alternatives.distribution: CDS ARCO Zarr subset with geo/time chunking; CDS API key required.
alternatives.existing_sourcecoop: Existing publisher ARCO service verified; SourceCoop equivalent not verified.

sources.supports: Global hourly record, native scale and reanalysis identity.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

sources.supports: Subset in ARCO Zarr, alternative chunking and required CDS API key.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

sources.supports: TerraClimate resolution, monthly product, v1.1 inputs and version restrictions.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

alternatives.remaining: Check exact ARCO variable/period availability. Overlapping physical quantities do not justify treating the products as identical registry entries.

groups.decision: Use GlaMBIE for updated aggregate mass change; keep Hugonnet when the 100 m spatial elevation-change maps are the needed product.

alternatives.name: GlaMBIE 2000-2023
alternatives.when_to_choose: Recent global and regional glacier mass-change statistics and comparisons.
alternatives.differences: Combines multiple observation methods and extends through 2023; regional/global series are not gridded 100 m elevation-change maps and cannot be substituted pixel-for-pixel.
alternatives.distribution: WGMS provides tabular CSV data; simple Parquet is plausible, with GeoParquet only if explicitly joining defined regional geometry.
alternatives.rights: WGMS states open access with correct citation; pin exact release terms before republishing.
alternatives.existing_sourcecoop: No exact entry found in targeted search; absence not established.

sources.supports: GlaMBIE release 1.0.0 and data DOI, publication coverage 2000-2023, rights and download.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.
Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

alternatives.remaining: Do not claim a scientific supersession of the spatial Hugonnet product. No new citation ranking was calculated.

alternatives.name: ITS_LIVE
alternatives.relationship: Related glacier/ice-sheet products; global velocity differs from elevation change
alternatives.when_to_choose: Ice-flow velocity or available regional ice-sheet elevation-change products.
alternatives.differences: Its global velocity products measure motion, not glacier surface elevation change. Elevation-change products listed for Greenland/Antarctica do not reproduce the global 100 m mountain-glacier maps.
alternatives.distribution: NASA/JPL advertises cloud access, including Zarr for velocity data.
alternatives.rights: Use the selected product-specific source terms and citations.
alternatives.existing_sourcecoop: No mirror verified or needed to establish existing producer access.

sources.supports: Product inventory distinguishes velocity from Greenland/Antarctic elevation-change offerings and cloud formats.
sources.basis: Primary producer, distributor or research-paper documentation; no data equivalence test.

alternatives.remaining: Select a concrete variable/product before comparing coverage; do not label the entire ITS_LIVE collection an elevation-map replacement.

limits: No scientifically equivalent replacement is asserted without a matching quantity, spatial/temporal support and method.
Cloud-native formats are publisher claims, not byte-level COG/Zarr conformance tests performed here.
Earthdata and CDS services require credentials; cloud-native does not imply anonymous access.
Search misses do not establish SourceCoop absence.
No dataset files or registry entries changed.
